title: Youth Sports Waiver Checklist
subtitle: Capture sport, season, guardian authority, and contact level; confirm equipment and coach release.
description: Youth Sports Waiver records sport, season, guardian authority, contact level, equipment, and coach release. Youth Sports Waiver evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this youth sports waiver stage-gated verification when staff must document sport and season. Reconcile guardian authority, contact level, equipment, and coach release before the youth sports waiver handoff. Use the season plan, team roster, guardian verification, disclosed contact conditions, equipment issue, coach brief, optional-activity choices, and player release. This acknowledgment concerns a player in a team season with practice and competition, contact level, coach supervision, protective gear, league rules, sideline release, and guardian choice. Ask the assigned youth sports waiver reviewer to confirm sport against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Youth Sports Waiver starting details review
sections.guidance: Name sport, season, team, participant and guardian authority, contact level, equipment, coaching supervision, alternative activity, and release. Record the youth sports waiver decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

blocks.label: Youth Sports Waiver required checks
items: Sport is identified for this record
Season matches the current request or source
Guardian authority is ready for point-of-use staff
Contact level limits or questions are resolved
Equipment is communicated to the responsible person
Coach release is confirmed at handoff
